# Campaign Overview Authoring Guide

The campaign overview is the human-readable guide to a campaign. It should let a reader (player, dungeon master, or collaborator) grasp what the campaign is about, how it plays, and who the important characters are at a glance. Write it to be scannable, warm, and consistent.

## Structure

A campaign overview file should contain the following, in this order:

1. Title: The title of the campaign, with an optional emoji prefix that fits the campaign's theme; the emoji is a stylistic choice, not a requirement.
2. Campaign Description: One or two short paragraphs under the title describing the premise, setting, and central stakes. This section needs no heading; it flows directly from the title.
3. Rules & Mechanics: The rules and mechanics of the campaign that are relevant to players and dungeon masters, which may include homebrew rules and mechanics. If there are no special rules or mechanics, this section should still be included with a note that the campaign uses the standard rules and mechanics of Dungeons & Dragons. Each rule or mechanic should be listed as a bullet point with a short description.
4. Characters: The notable characters in the campaign, including villains, companions, and NPCs. Characters should be listed in a consistent format, with a heading for each character and a short paragraph describing them. Ensure that descriptions are not too long, and that they are written in a similar style and tone to each other. Each character should be described in terms of their appearance, mannerisms, temperament, personality, and role or notable ability within the campaign. Include any signature items, locations, or mechanics associated with the character.

```md
# {Optional Emoji} {Title}

{Campaign Description}

---

## 📖 Campaign Rules & Mechanics

* {Rules & Mechanics List Item}: {Description of the rule or mechanic}
* {Rules & Mechanics List Item}: {Description of the rule or mechanic}

---

## 👤 Characters

### {Character Name} {*(Optional Character Information)*}
{Character Description}

### {Character Name} {*(Optional Character Information)*}
{Character Description}

...
```

## Consistency Checklist

Use this checklist to ensure that the campaign overview file is complete and consistent:

- [ ] Title: Included at the top of the file and adheres to the expected format.
- [ ] Description: Included immediately after the title.
- [ ] Campaign Rules and Mechanics: Included after the description.
- [ ] Rules/Mechanics List: A list of rules and mechanics, including homebrew are listed, or a note that the campaign uses standard D&D rules and mechanics.
- [ ] Characters: Included after the rules and mechanics.
- [ ] Character List: A list of characters, each with a heading and a description.
